name: Pelvic floor physiotherapy
summary: How expats access pelvic floor physio in Singapore — postpartum referral paths, AHPC-registered therapists, male pelvic issues, and what to expect in assessment sessions.
body:
Pelvic floor physiotherapy helps with postpartum recovery, incontinence, prolapse symptoms, and some male pelvic pain. Care usually starts with a GP or O&G referral, then an AHPC-registered physiotherapist who does an individualised assessment.

## Decision points
- Postpartum check timing vs early symptoms
- Internal vs external assessment consent
- Male pelvic physio pathways
- Home exercise programme vs clinic-heavy plans
- Insurance / corporate panel coverage for physio

Bring delivery notes or urology letters when available.

## How to choose
Prefer AHPC-registered physiotherapists with pelvic health training. Ask about privacy setup and chaperone options. Confirm session length and whether follow-ups can be telehealth for exercise review.

## Practical tip
Schedule the first visit when you can rest afterward — assessment days are not the moment for back-to-back meetings.
